title: VERIFY:A Study to Compare Combination Regimen With Vildagliptin & Metformin Versus Metformin in Treatment-naïve Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study was to determine whether the initiation of a vildagliptin plus metformin combination regimen would result in more durable glycemic control than metformin monotherapy in treatment-naïve patients with type-2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

Posted outcomes: Time to Initial Treatment Failure. timeframe=Visit 4 (Week 13) up to End of Study (Study Drug Discontinuation or Premature Su. Vilda 50mg Bid + Metformin=7.81; Placebo + Metformin=19.97. p=<0.001
